speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a full thumb short of the notch. It was short before the knife touched it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the same notch as last week, and it is still a penny.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She will not cut another to make the difference up. I have heard that already this morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I will not. A penny buys this loaf, and this loaf is what the penny bought.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will eat it short. I am not here to reprice a Monday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The heel is the short part. Take the crumb if you are being proud.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He may take either. He may not tell me the notch has moved.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The notch has not moved. The loaf has. I can see which.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then eat, and leave the dresser out of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A full thumb, and not a hair more. I measured.
